issues.jp_before: うちの子[こ]は友達[ともだち]におもちゃを{あげて|gv-ageru}しまいました。
issues.problem: English 'gave all the toys away' adds 'all', which is not in the Japanese.
issues.action: English changed to 'My child went and gave a toy away to a friend.'

issues.jp_before: 父[ちち]は毎年[まいとし]、子供[こども]たちにお年玉[としだま]を{あげます|gv-ageru}。
issues.problem: 子供たち can be read as my father's own children (me and my siblings), and then くれます is correct, so the distractor is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Changed to 親戚[しんせき]の子供[こども]たち ('our relatives' children'); English and why updated to match.

issues.jp_before: 彼[かれ]に手作[てづく]りのクッキーを{あげたい|gv-ageru}と思[おも]います。
issues.problem: English 'I think I want to give' is an unnatural literal translation of 〜たいと思います.
issues.action: English changed to 'I'd like to give him some home-made cookies.'

issues.jp_before: 夫[おっと]には毎年[まいとし]、誕生日[たんじょうび]にネクタイを{あげます|gv-ageru}。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the item 姉は彼氏にネクタイをあげました (same gift).
issues.action: Gift changed to 好[す]きなお酒[さけ]; English updated.

issues.jp_before: 読[よ]み終[お]わった本[ほん]は、いつも図書館[としょかん]に{あげます|gv-ageru}。
issues.problem: Unnatural: giving books to an institution such as a library is 寄付する / 寄贈する, not あげる.
issues.action: Rewritten as 読[よ]み終[お]わった漫画[まんが]は、いつも弟[おとうと]に{あげます|gv-ageru}。 with matching English and why; lv 4.

issues.jp_before: 母[はは]は友達[ともだち]に自分[じぶん]で作[つく]った漬物[つけもの]を{あげて|gv-ageru}います。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of 母は友達のお母さんに自分で作ったジャムをあげました (same giver, same frame).
issues.action: Rewritten as 父[ちち]は、もう読[よ]まない雑誌[ざっし]を会社[かいしゃ]の後輩[こうはい]に{あげて|gv-ageru}います。 with new English and why.
